name: Murata Toshiya
source:
Star Sign: Aquarius

The manager of a rival store to La Crima called 'Blue Moon'.
He used to work at a jewelry store and is very skilled in giving advice about fashion and accessorizing.
Even though [url=/c41753]Satoru[/url] is his rival, he has a lot of respect towards him.
